coreClaim: A tracked message replacement prepares the next durable append checkpoint before returning, so the next generated message does not copy both large primary collections in the foreground.

inScope: Messages and message-swipes append checkpoint backups
Tracked single- and multi-collection replacement paths
Conversation and Roleplay foreground persistence latency
outOfScope: Message import behavior beyond checkpoint preparation

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Tracked replacements leave an empty checkpoint with dedicated snapshots of the installed messages and message-swipes primaries.
outOfScopeClaims: The journal entry shape is unchanged; new entries use version 2 while version 1 remains readable.
Normal collection .bak files retain previous-version corruption recovery semantics.
Shutdown materialization remains allowed to finish durable journal replay.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: After a full tracked replacement invalidated the append checkpoint, the next generated message synchronously copied the 8 MB messages primary and 13 MB swipe primary before appending.
contractLaneGate.producer: marinara-storage replacement and append checkpoint lifecycle
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A foreground generated-message append should write bounded journal and row bytes, not prepare full-primary recovery snapshots.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Tracked replacement paths prepare a dedicated empty append checkpoint after the replacement commits. The next append reuses those snapshots without changing their file identities.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: FileStorage and append_journal own replacement, checkpoint preparation, backup separation, and legacy recovery.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not suppress message persistence, weaken sync, or hide the storage wait in optimistic UI.
regressionProof: Assert an empty append journal already exists after replacement.
Record both dedicated checkpoint backup identities.
Append a new message and swipe.
Assert both checkpoint backup identities remain unchanged.
Remove a dedicated backup from a pending checkpoint and prove startup can recover from the legacy .bak fallback.

positiveRows.claim: Replacement prepares the next checkpoint before a generated append.
Deployed legacy pending checkpoints remain recoverable.

contradictionRows.claim: Checkpoint preparation must not overwrite normal corruption-recovery backups.
contradictionRows.evidence: repeated_writes_refresh_existing_backup and writes_refresh_backup_without_copying_nul_corruption pass in the full storage suite.

contradictionRows.claim: Existing append recovery and fail-closed behavior must remain intact.
contradictionRows.evidence: The full marinara-storage suite passes 148 tests.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: A pending checkpoint created by the previous release can still use messages.json.bak or message-swipes.json.bak if its dedicated snapshot is absent.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: checkpoint_backup_for_recovery falls back to backup_path_for and the legacy regression passes.

untestedRows: Post-merge Raspberry Pi Conversation and Roleplay timing are verified after the matching ARM64 image is deployed.

ownedFacts.description: On exact Pi merge a557f895, the first Roleplay user-message create after checkpoint invalidation took 4735.977 ms.
The filesystem trace showed messages.json.bak and message-swipes.json.bak being copied for about five seconds immediately before the first message append.
The next assistant message create took 42.814 ms after the checkpoint already existed.

userActionCopy.description: No migration or cleanup is required. Dedicated checkpoint snapshots are storage-managed recovery files.
userActionCopy.source: Legacy layout: messages.json.bak and message-swipes.json.bak with version 1 pending entries
userActionCopy.destination: Current layout: dedicated append-checkpoint backups with version 2 entries; migration is automatic
